$head_prefix
% The docodin book: docs/theme/book.tex, filled by `docodin book build`
% with the parts of the native xetex writer ($generator).
\usepackage{fontspec}
% straight double quotes (defined in T1 but missing in TU)
\ifdefined\XeTeXrevision
  \DeclareTextCommand{\textquotedbl}{\UnicodeEncodingName}{%
    {\addfontfeatures{RawFeature=-tlig,Mapping=}\char34}}%
\fi
$requirements
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{$secnumdepth}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{$tocdepth}

%%% Page, colours and fonts
\usepackage[a4paper,top=25mm,bottom=27mm,inner=27mm,outer=24mm,
  headheight=15pt,headsep=10mm,footskip=12mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{dodInk}{HTML}{141B2D}
\definecolor{dodInkSoft}{HTML}{3A4358}
\definecolor{dodMuted}{HTML}{667085}
\definecolor{dodAccent}{HTML}{2F5BEA}
\definecolor{dodAccentDeep}{HTML}{1B2A55}
\definecolor{dodAccentLight}{HTML}{9FC0FF}
\definecolor{dodRule}{HTML}{D6DBE6}
\definecolor{dodCode}{HTML}{F4F6FA}
\definecolor{dodTip}{HTML}{0F8A5F}
\definecolor{dodWarn}{HTML}{C77700}
\definecolor{dodDanger}{HTML}{C62F3E}
\definecolor{dodSee}{HTML}{5B6478}
\setmainfont{SourceSerif4}[Extension=.otf, UprightFont=*-Regular,
  ItalicFont=*-RegularIt, BoldFont=*-Semibold, BoldItalicFont=*-SemiboldIt]
\setsansfont{SourceSans3}[Extension=.otf, UprightFont=*-Regular,
  ItalicFont=*-RegularIt, BoldFont=*-Semibold, BoldItalicFont=*-SemiboldIt]
\setmonofont{SourceCodePro}[Extension=.otf, UprightFont=*-Regular,
  ItalicFont=*-RegularIt, BoldFont=*-Semibold, BoldItalicFont=*-SemiboldIt, Scale=0.86]
\usepackage{microtype}
% Allow inline paths and identifiers to wrap without inserting a printed hyphen.
% Copy robust commands without retaining their original internal name.
\NewCommandCopy{\dodOriginalTexttt}{\texttt}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\RenewDocumentCommand {\texttt} {m} {
  \group_begin:
  \tl_set:Nn \l_tmpa_tl {#1}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {.} {.\allowbreak}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {/} {/\allowbreak}
  \tl_replace_all:Nnn \l_tmpa_tl {\_} {\_\allowbreak}
  \exp_args:NV \dodOriginalTexttt \l_tmpa_tl
  \group_end:
}
\ExplSyntaxOff
\linespread{1.08}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{3em}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.45em plus 0.1em}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\color{dodInk}

%%% Headings
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\part}[display]
  {\centering\sffamily}
  {\large\bfseries\color{dodAccent}\MakeUppercase{\partname}\ \thepart}
  {1.4em}
  {\fontsize{30}{36}\selectfont\bfseries\color{dodInk}}
  [\vspace{1.2em}{\color{dodAccent}\rule{5em}{2.5pt}}]
\titleformat{name=\part,numberless}[display]
  {\centering\sffamily}{}{0pt}
  {\fontsize{30}{36}\selectfont\bfseries\color{dodInk}}
  [\vspace{1.2em}{\color{dodAccent}\rule{5em}{2.5pt}}]
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]
  {\sffamily\color{dodInk}}
  {\normalsize\bfseries\color{dodAccent}\MakeUppercase{\chaptertitlename}\ \thechapter}
  {0.5em}
  {\fontsize{26}{31}\selectfont\bfseries}
  [\vspace{0.5em}{\color{dodRule}\titlerule[0.8pt]}]
\titleformat{name=\chapter,numberless}[display]
  {\sffamily\color{dodInk}}{}{0pt}
  {\fontsize{26}{31}\selectfont\bfseries}
  [\vspace{0.5em}{\color{dodRule}\titlerule[0.8pt]}]
\titlespacing*{\chapter}{0pt}{0pt}{2.2em}
\titleformat{\section}
  {\sffamily\Large\bfseries\color{dodInk}}{\color{dodAccent}\thesection}{0.75em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}
  {\sffamily\large\bfseries\color{dodInk}}{\color{dodAccent}\thesubsection}{0.7em}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}
  {\sffamily\normalsize\bfseries\color{dodInkSoft}}{\thesubsubsection}{0.6em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{1.8em}{0.6em}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{1.4em}{0.4em}
\titlespacing*{\subsubsection}{0pt}{1.2em}{0.3em}

%%% Running heads
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\headrule}{{\color{dodRule}\hrule width\headwidth height\headrulewidth}}
\fancyhead[LE]{\sffamily\small\color{dodMuted}\leftmark}
\fancyhead[RO]{\sffamily\small\color{dodMuted}\rightmark}
\fancyfoot[LE,RO]{\sffamily\small\bfseries\color{dodAccent}\thepage}
\fancyfoot[RE,LO]{\sffamily\footnotesize\color{dodMuted}$title}
\fancypagestyle{plain}{\fancyhf{}\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}%
  \fancyfoot[LE,RO]{\sffamily\small\bfseries\color{dodAccent}\thepage}}

%%% Table of contents
\usepackage{tocloft}
\renewcommand{\cfttoctitlefont}{\sffamily\fontsize{26}{31}\selectfont\bfseries\color{dodInk}}
\renewcommand{\cftpartfont}{\sffamily\large\bfseries\color{dodAccent}}
\renewcommand{\cftpartpagefont}{\sffamily\large\bfseries\color{dodAccent}}
\renewcommand{\cftchapfont}{\sffamily\bfseries}
\renewcommand{\cftchappagefont}{\sffamily\bfseries}
\renewcommand{\cftsecfont}{\sffamily}
\renewcommand{\cftsecpagefont}{\sffamily\color{dodMuted}}
\setlength{\cftbeforechapskip}{0.55em}
\setlength{\cftbeforepartskip}{1.4em}

%%% Boxes: code, admonitions
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\newtcolorbox{dodcode}{enhanced, breakable, colback=dodCode, colframe=dodRule,
  boxrule=0.5pt, arc=3pt, left=8pt, right=8pt, top=5pt, bottom=5pt,
  before skip=0.7em, after skip=0.9em, fontupper=\small}
\newcommand{\dodadmcolor}{dodAccent}
\newenvironment{DUadmonition}
  {\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, breakable, colback=\dodadmcolor!6!white,
     colframe=\dodadmcolor, boxrule=0pt, leftrule=3pt, arc=2pt, outer arc=2pt,
     left=10pt, right=10pt, top=6pt, bottom=6pt, before skip=0.8em, after skip=0.9em]}
  {\end{tcolorbox}}
\newcommand{\DUtitle}[1]{\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\color{\dodadmcolor}#1}\par\smallskip}
\newcommand{\dodadmonition}[2]{%
  \expandafter\def\csname DUCLASS#1\endcsname{\renewcommand{\dodadmcolor}{#2}}%
  \expandafter\def\csname endDUCLASS#1\endcsname{}}
\dodadmonition{note}{dodAccent}
\dodadmonition{hint}{dodTip}
\dodadmonition{tip}{dodTip}
\dodadmonition{important}{dodAccentDeep}
\dodadmonition{attention}{dodWarn}
\dodadmonition{caution}{dodWarn}
\dodadmonition{warning}{dodWarn}
\dodadmonition{danger}{dodDanger}
\dodadmonition{error}{dodDanger}
\dodadmonition{seealso}{dodSee}
% code blocks (the literal blocks of code-block and code have the class "code")
\newenvironment{DUCLASScode}
  {\begin{dodcode}\renewenvironment{quote}{\par\raggedright}{\par}}
  {\end{dodcode}}
\newcommand{\DUroleln}[1]{{\color{dodMuted}\footnotesize #1}}
\newcommand{\DUrolehll}[1]{{\color{dodAccentDeep}\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\DUrolekbd}[1]{\fcolorbox{dodRule}{dodCode}{\ttfamily\footnotesize #1}}
\newcommand{\DUroleguilabel}[1]{{\sffamily\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\DUrolemenuselection}[1]{{\sffamily\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\DUroleaccelerator}[1]{\underline{#1}}
\newcommand{\DUrolecommand}[1]{{\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\DUroleprogram}[1]{{\bfseries #1}}
\newcommand{\DUroleversionmodified}[1]{{\sffamily\bfseries\color{dodAccentDeep}#1}}
\newcommand{\DUrubric}[1]{\par\medskip{\sffamily\bfseries\color{dodAccent}#1}\par}
\def\DUCLASScentered{\centering}
\def\endDUCLASScentered{}
\newcommand{\DUrolecaption}[1]{{\sffamily\small\bfseries\color{dodInkSoft}#1}}

%%% Docutils' definitions not given above
$fallbacks
$pdfsetup
\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, linkcolor=dodAccentDeep, urlcolor=dodAccent,
  citecolor=dodAccentDeep, pdftitle={$title}, pdfauthor={$author},
  pdfsubject={$tagline}, pdfcreator={$generator}}

\begin{document}
\frontmatter

  \node[anchor=south west, inner sep=0pt, text width=0.74\paperwidth]

     {\fontsize{12}{14}\selectfont\bfseries\color{dodAccentLight}%
      \MakeUppercase{Version $version}}\par\vspace{10pt}%

     {\fontsize{17}{22}\selectfont\color{dodAccentLight} $tagline}};
  \node[anchor=north west, inner sep=0pt, text width=0.74\paperwidth]

  \node[anchor=south west, inner sep=0pt]
    at ([xshift=0.13\paperwidth, yshift=0.06\paperheight]current page.south west)

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{titlepage}
